headline: Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements and statutory tax exemptions during July 28, 2026 meeting.
summary: The Board of Assessors approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements, including two for denial, and approved statutory exemption applications across several clauses. One Clause 41C application was denied by signatures, and no new or old business was discussed.
decisions: Approved Motor Vehicle Excise Abatements for the week of July 13 to July 17 by signatures.
Approved denial of 2 Motor Vehicle Excise Tax abatements.
Approved statutory exemption applications for Clause 17E (2), Clause 22D (4), Clause 22E (9), Clause 37A (4), Clause 41C (11), Clause 42 (1), and Clause 22 (17).

decision_evidence.quote: Week of July 13 to July 17 – Approved by signatures
MVE Abatements for denial – 2, R. Rondeau made a motion to approve, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.

Statutory Exemptions – Clause 17E: 2 applications, Clause 22D: 4 applications, Clause 22E: 9 applications, Clause 37A: 4 applications, Clause 41C: 11 applications, Clause 42: 1 application, Clause 22: 17 applications – R. Rondeau made a motion to approve these applications, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
1 Clause 41C application was denied by signatures
